mapper.select: SELECT a.acc_id AS id, a.account_number AS accountId, c.name AS holderName, a.balance AS cashBalance, a.status AS status, a.version AS version, a.updated_at AS lastUpdated FROM accounts a INNER JOIN clients c ON c.acc_id = a.acc_id WHERE a.acc_id = #{accountId}
SELECT a.acc_id AS accountId, a.balance AS cashBalance, a.base_currency AS currency, a.updated_at AS asOf FROM accounts a WHERE a.acc_id = #{accountId}

SELECT p.account_id AS accountId, i.ticker AS symbol, CAST(ph.quantity AS INTEGER) AS quantity, ph.avg_cost AS averageCost FROM portfolio_holdings ph INNER JOIN portfolio p ON p.portfolio_id = ph.portfolio_id INNER JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = ph.instrument_id WHERE p.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY i.ticker ASC
SELECT acc_id, balance, base_currency, status, version FROM accounts WHERE acc_id = #{accountId}
